spots.name: Mural No Estamos Pa Semilla pero Mira Como Florecemos de Las Guardianas del Conchalito
spots.blurb: You've reached Mural No Estamos Pa Semilla pero Mira Como Florecemos de Las Guardianas del Conchalito, a mural by Cuchara Taller de Arquitectura. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
